interpretation: Reviewed does not mean completed or excluded. Entries can overlap and contain several subclaims.

entries.claim: A cheap, skip-aware, MULTI-REGISTER prefilter (sieve) can screen a PRNG keyspace at >=100x reduction while retaining >=0.90 of true keys per register, making the enumerable 2012-Linux generator families affordable to sweep. Load-bearing precondition for all of Round 20's Phase S.
The decoder-path statistic n_skips (the rejection-loop footprint) separates a correct key from wrong keys at PAGE-WINDOW length, and can therefore serve as a language-free sieve statistic.

Standing red-team lane (doctrine R6). Target: Round 20's own claims -- does P1 manufacture survival, is Phase S a silent re-run, does the sieve interact with the panel-max null, and can a row be certified on score alone?
Re-adjudicating the stored B-04 English-argmax survivors through the repaired, recovery-gated instrument recovers a key the original English-only sweep discarded. No new key space.

The pad is one of the 679 held Marsaglia CDROM physical-randomness units (~21 CPU-h). This is the round's HONEST CONTROL: real physical randomness, so a survival number here would mean what we think it means.
